claim_scope: For every n>=4 and every unordered pair 0<=p<q<n, exact minimum word length from the full image to Q minus that pair, and its exact histogram.
integrity: The universal proof combines explicit shortest witnesses with a rank-monotone potential; checker.py supplies independent finite BFS and local potential comparisons. Mathematical and novelty checks are same-model only.
scientific_limitations: Exact images with two missing states in the standard Černý family only; not a general synchronizing-automaton bound. The already known maximum 2n, unique maximizer, short two-merge existence theorem, and minimum rank-loss-two length are not claimed new separately. Historical priority awaits independent scrutiny.
title: Exact two-hole reaching distances in the Černý automata
